Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.5.

Support line and live Google Drive backup
- Support number 0303 676 3939: call it, WhatsApp it, or tap "Send error log on WhatsApp" to send the latest errors straight to support.
- Backup & Support > Live backup to Google Drive: sign in once, then a fresh copy of everything goes to your Drive a few minutes after anything changes (and when a shift starts or ends). The newest copy plus one file per day (last 14 days).
- Restore from Drive: pick any copy from your Drive and restore everything.
- Free: it uses your own Google Drive (one-time setup steps are shown in the app).
